groups.note: 食い違い: 韓国語は「米国人の最初の反応はこの上なく冷たかった」、英語 E1 は「はじめは温かくもてなしたが、冷たく敵対的になっていった」とする
diff: The Korean original says the Americans’ first reaction to him was utterly cold (English edition: “The initial warm hospitality shown to me by Americans began to grow cold, even hostile”).

groups.note: 食い違い: 聴衆の反応を韓国語は「わあ、わあと歓声を上げた」、英語 E25 は「レバレンド・ムーンの話を聞きたい！」とする
diff: The Korean original says the audience simply roared with cheers (English edition: “We want to hear Reverend Moon!”).

groups.note: E30〜E32（混乱の時代の若者に新しい励ましとなった／純潔と真の家庭の話に賛同して叫んだ／その熱気に僕も汗をかいた）は英語だけ
diff: The English edition places here three sentences that the Korean original has in the next section, right after the Washington Monument speech (that his teaching was a fresh shock to young Americans living in an age of confusion, that they cheered his message of purity and true families, and that their fervor made him sweat).
